event.title: Add explicit forensic report quality gate so incomplete scans are not reported as success
event.summary: Audit manifest now classifies missing/failed substudies, mutated source files, journal discrepancies, unknown settings and corrupt market data. It always prohibits automatic live tuning and returns nonzero for incomplete scans.

changes.summary: Conservative local audit quality gate, explicitly separating completeness from broker confirmation.
Six synthetic quality gate unit tests and safety invariants.
Persist quality_gate.json and exit code 2 on incomplete audit.
Explain quality classifications and strict limits on strategy deployment.
